purpose: Defines the information an implementation plan must hold: tasks, ordering, dependencies, state, traceability, and task groups, so the next executable task is determined uniquely.
summary: Plan is a JSON work artifact created by start-plan and consumed by start-implement
Tasks have unique IDs, priority, and dependency IDs
Task states: not started, running, implemented, completed, failed
Executable task is uniquely determined by state, dependencies, and priority
Traceability from requirements to designs to tasks with gap detection
Task granularity executable by a single executor agent
Each task lists documents required for implementation
Plan is temporary and holds no additive-feature identifier
Task groups are units of selection, build check, and review
tasks: Designing plan JSON schema or validation
Grouping tasks for build and review
title: REQ-024 実装計画書 要件定義書
